title: Agent Safety Object Model
description: Version 2.0.0 of the machine-readable governance profile for a delegated agent. It ties the agent to the six state variables: each action class points at the authority grant that authorizes it instead of carrying an approval flag; the capability catalog, dependency record, intervention spec, and substrate profile are referenced by identifier. The 1.1.0 instance at /standards/agent-safety-object-model.json remains served unchanged; this schema replaces its stop_override_authority with intervention_ref and drops approval_required from action classes.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this schema the model conforms to. 2.x models reference grants; 1.x models carried approval flags.

agent_id.title: Agent identifier
agent_id.description: Stable identifier that ties receipts, grants, incidents, and evidence packs to one agent.

autonomy_level.title: Autonomy level
autonomy_level.description: Whether the agent drafts, recommends, or executes actions, and under what guardrails.

description.title: Description
description.description: Plain-language statement of what the level permits.

action_classes.title: Action classes
action_classes.description: Each consequential action class the agent can reach, with the grant that authorizes it. There is no approval flag: authorization lives in the grant's state.

items.title: Action class
items.description: One action class and its authorizing grant.

class.title: Class
class.description: Name of the action class, such as READ, WRITE, or TRANSFER.

reversible.title: Reversible
reversible.description: Whether actions in this class can be undone.

grant_ref.title: Grant reference
grant_ref.description: Identifier of the authority grant that authorizes this class, or null when the class is discoverable but not granted.

capability_catalog_ref.title: Capability catalog reference
capability_catalog_ref.description: Identifier of the capability catalog describing what the agent can do.

dependency_ref.title: Dependency reference
dependency_ref.description: Identifier of the dependency record for the agent.

intervention_ref.title: Intervention reference
intervention_ref.description: Identifier of the intervention spec that replaces stop_override_authority: who can halt, hold, override, narrow, or revoke the agent.

substrate_profile_ref.title: Substrate profile reference
substrate_profile_ref.description: Identifier of the substrate profile classifying the agent's deployment.

receipt_schema.title: Receipt schema
receipt_schema.description: The decision receipt schema the agent emits.

href.title: Link
href.description: Path or URL of the receipt schema.

clocks.title: Clocks
clocks.description: Acknowledgement, review, and remedy clocks in hours.

ack.title: Acknowledgement clock
ack.description: Hours to acknowledge a contested decision.

evidence_pack_references.title: Evidence pack references
evidence_pack_references.description: Evidence packs the agent's operation must produce.

items.title: Evidence pack reference
items.description: One evidence pack, by standard and location.

href.title: Link
href.description: Path or URL of the evidence pack.

required_signals.title: Required signals
required_signals.description: Telemetry signals the agent must emit for its grants to remain reviewable.

mapped_mechanisms.title: Mapped mechanisms
mapped_mechanisms.description: Mechanisms from the catalog that implement this model's controls.

items.title: Mechanism reference
items.description: One mechanism, by identifier and location.

href.title: Link
href.description: Path or URL of the mechanism.
